title: Founder Cards: How to Request and Manage
summary: This document explains how to request up to 3 Founder Cards (choosing physical or virtual issuance, adding recipient details, and setting spending controls/delivery or activation preferences) and how to manage them (activate, freeze/unfreeze, replace, set category/merchant/individual limits, and review transactions in real time). It also notes that domestic wire reimbursements/fund settlements have a $15.00 fee and that the account includes 5 free incoming domestic wires per month, plus operational tips like creating a founder card policy and using alerts for large/unusual transactions.
faqs: How many Founder Cards can I request, and where do I start the request?
What spending controls and recipient details do I need to set when requesting Founder Cards?
How do I issue Founder Cards as physical or virtual, and how do I set delivery/activation preferences?
From where can I activate, freeze/unfreeze, or replace existing Founder Cards?
Can I set merchant/category controls and individual transaction limits per founder cardholder?
What fees and monthly limits apply when I reimburse founders or fund settlements using domestic wire?
